## Instructor

::: {.course}
<p class="course-title">PhD Computational Economics Bootcamp</p>
<p class="course-meta"><span class="role">Instructor</span><span class="sep">·</span>Summer 2026</p>

A four-week introduction to computational methods for economics, taught in Julia: numerical methods, parallelization and dynamic programming, and distributions, equilibrium, and estimation.

[Course website →](https://uw-econ-bootcamp-2026.github.io/)
:::
